assertions.name: published posts exist
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM post

assertions.name: collections exist
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM collection

assertions.name: fts index populated
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM post_fts

assertions.name: thread collection union preserves both collections
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection

assertions.name: shared collection metadata is aggregated across the thread
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection WHERE site_id = 'sit_01kme7j7j1f4m7s2k8r5c9t0qb' AND thread_id = 'pst_01kme7ja2mf4m7s2k8r5c9t0qf' AND collection_id = 'col_01kme7j8f9f4m7s2k8r5c9t0qc' AND created_at = 1774200040 AND position = 1 AND pinned_at = 1774200500

assertions.name: child-only collection becomes thread membership
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection WHERE site_id = 'sit_01kme7j7j1f4m7s2k8r5c9t0qb' AND thread_id = 'pst_01kme7ja2mf4m7s2k8r5c9t0qf' AND collection_id = 'col_01kme7j8f9f4m7s2k8r5c9t0qd' AND created_at = 1774200060 AND position = 4 AND pinned_at = 1774200600

assertions.name: thread collection targets are roots
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM thread_collection tc INNER JOIN post root ON root.site_id = tc.site_id AND root.id = tc.thread_id WHERE root.reply_to_id IS NOT NULL OR root.thread_id <> root.id

assertions.name: legacy post collection table is removed
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'post_collection'
